verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler-based UI framework, not an agent or AI host, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows Svelte publishes its own MCP server for coding agents to use, which is the server role and a separate story; it does not show Svelte acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
